description: A colour contrast fixer — the nearest accessible colour that passes WCAG AA. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

adjust.description: Which colour may change. Only its lightness moves; hue and saturation are kept. 'either' tries both and returns the smallest change first. Defaults to either.

background.description: The colour behind the text, in the same forms as foreground.

foreground.description: The text colour, as hex, rgb(), hsl() or a CSS colour name.

level.description: The WCAG grade to reach. AA is normal body text at 4.5:1, AA_LARGE is large text at 3:1, AAA is 7:1 and AAA_LARGE is 4.5:1. Defaults to AA.

name: contrast_fixer
title: Contrast Fixer
